properties.displayName: AI Hub: Content Safety block (Hate, SelfHarm, Sexual, Violence)
properties.description: Fires on any APIM rejection where the Content Safety category indicates Hate, SelfHarm, Sexual, or Violence. Scoped via diagnostic settings to the AI Hub APIM instance only.

allOf.query: ApiManagementGatewayLogs | where ResponseCode == 403 | where LastErrorReason has 'content-safety' or LastErrorReason has 'Hate' or LastErrorReason has 'SelfHarm' or LastErrorReason has 'Sexual' or LastErrorReason has 'Violence' | summarize Count = count()
